opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: up to £200 (Scheme A); up to £500 (standard Scheme B); up to £750 (Adelphi co‑sponsored Scheme B); up to £300 (virtual Scheme C)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scheme A: undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva. Schemes B & C: PhD student and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva. Applicants must be UK‑based members (or non‑UK members attending UK conferences).
opportunities.summary: Grants to support attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at genetics‑related conferences (Society meetings, other meetings, or virtual conferences).

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members who are studying or working in the UK (or attending a UK‑based course). Students must be members; others need at least one year of membership.
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £1,200 to enable members to attend formal short training courses or collaborative visits for genetics/genomics techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members who are studying or working in the UK (or intend to carry out fieldwork in the UK). Students must be members; others need at least one year of membership.
opportunities.summary: Awards to cover travel and accommodation costs for field‑based genetic research projects, with results suitable for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Grants to support public engagement activities (in‑person or virtual) related to genetics, covering travel and material costs.

opportunities.title: Carer’s Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member, regardless of age of the person they are caring for.
opportunities.summary: Award to support members with caring responsibilities to attend Society meetings or events.

opportunities.title: One‑off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: several hundred pounds up to a few thousand pounds (typical major sponsorship £1,000‑£2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Genetics Society proposing a genetics‑themed meeting not organised directly by the Society.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic‑themed meetings (one‑off) with support for travel, accommodation, and other direct costs, including a Carer’s Award.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group Funding (SIG)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members forming a new Special Interest Group wishing to run regular series of meetings.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research meetings on particular themes, supporting speaker travel, accommodation, publicity, and other direct meeting costs.
